EXPLANATORY SYSTEM DIAGRAM

01 / CONTEXT

The idea.

A set of microservices exercises exploring service discovery, HTTP communication and dependency failures. The library service discovers student and book services through a registry before processing a borrowing request.

02 / ENGINEERING

The design problem.

Coordinating dependent services while making unavailable dependencies visible to callers.

The library example uses registry lookups, request timeouts and explicit error responses. A separate circuit-breaker exercise counts failures, opens the circuit after three failures, and attempts recovery after a ten-second interval.

03 / IMPLEMENTATION

Inside the project.

  • Registry-based discovery of student and book services
  • HTTP request timeouts and unavailable-service responses
  • Separate circuit-breaker exercise with three states
  • Failure counting and a timed recovery attempt

These are separate educational prototypes, not one production platform. Circuit-breaker state is held in process memory.
